class.name: FoxInteractionRayCast3D
class.brief_description: A specialized raycast for detecting and managing focus on [FoxInteractableArea3D] nodes.
class.description: [b]Note:[/b] Ensure the raycast's Collision Mask is set only to your Interactables physics layer for optimal performance.

method.name: get_current_target
method.description: Returns the [FoxInteractableArea3D] currently being hovered over, or [code]null[/code] if none.

method.name: interact_with_target
method.description: Attempts to interact with the currently focused target, passing the given [param context].

members.member: How far the raycast will project along the local -Z axis. Leave as [code]-1.0[/code] to ignore and use the manual [member RayCast3D.target_position].

signal.name: interaction_range_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the [member interaction_range] is modified.
